rule: VAR is a BINDING, never a sheet line by itself. The converter resolves the variable's producer chain corpus-wide exactly as bonus_stack_reader.rs::resolve_producer_chain_corpus_wide does (DEFINE base + every BONUS:VAR addend for that name, each gated by its own trailing PRE), maps the chain to one Expr, and INLINES that Expr wherever the closure consumes the name: a DESC `%N` argument (prose number), a SPELLS DC=/CASTERLEVEL=/TIMES= field (the SLA line), another BONUS's formula or PRE gate, or a PREVAR* gate. Consumer census, corpus-wide by instance (denominator 27,331): consumed by DESC 9,938; by SPELLS 1,230; by SAB/ASPECT/BENEFIT 1,127; only by other BONUS/PRE tokens 11,766; by nothing in the corpus 3,946 (877 distinct names). The no-corpus-consumer names are consumed by PCGen system rows that are not corpus records; the converter maps them by a fixed NAME table (per name, not per record): AC_Natural_Armor (1,574) -> COMBAT|AC TYPE=NaturalArmor; DarkvisionRange (344) -> VISION Darkvision; CMB_<m>/CMD_<m> -> the CMB/CMD line for maneuver m; SLA_CL -> CasterLevel of the record's SLAs; HasLowlightVision/HasLowLightVision/Mindless/RaceSizeIsLong/NoTypeTraits and every TYPE=Boolean VAR (1,709 instances) -> a flag: Text, no number; ARG_RaceBuilderPoints/TempEvolution*/Pool_*/DomainTaken -> builder bookkeeping: Metadata (no line). A name in none of those sets and consumed by nothing emits no line and no refusal. Formula mapping (F1..F9 AST from formula_interpreter.rs, then table): integer -> Const; TL -> Level; CL -> ClassLevel(owning class of the record; refuse when the record has no owning class); CL=X and classlevel("X") -> ClassLevel(X); classlevel("APPLIEDAS=NONEPIC") and bare classlevel() -> ClassLevel(owning class); HD -> HitDice; BAB -> BaseAttack; SIZE -> Size; STR..CHA -> AbilityMod; STRSCORE..CHASCORE -> AbilityScore (PCGen TermEvaluatorBuilderPCVar.java: bare abbreviation = modifier, +SCORE = score); + - * / -> Sum/Sum(Mul(-1))/Mul/Div; min/max n-ary -> nested Min/Max; floor(x) -> x (Div already floors); a DEFINEd identifier -> its own chain, recursively; %LIST/%CHOICE -> Choice. Per-formula refusals (corpus-wide, of 27,331): identifier neither built-in nor DEFINEd anywhere 1,177 (231 distinct names, e.g. BloodlinePower1TimesBonus 84, BoonCompanionBonus_AnimalCompanion 40, VitalistLVL 23 -- a PCGen data defect or a variable owned by a book not ingested); var(...) 75; skillinfo(...) 71; count(...) 36; charbonusto(...) 26; mastervar(...) 9; decimal literal 1. These are formula-shape refusals reported per shape, not per unit.
expr_shape: Sum([Const(10), SpellLevel, AbilityMod(Cha)]) for a DC chain; Sum([Const(2), <gated Const(1)>, <gated Const(1)>]) for a level-stepped chain (see gap E1)
expr_gaps: E1 conditional term: PREVARGTEQ-gated addends and if()/comparison arithmetic (615 if( calls, 1,299 PREVARGTEQ gates on VAR) need Expr::If(Cond, then, else) with Cond = Cmp(Expr, op, Expr) | And. Exact fallback inside the existing vocabulary: (X>=k) == Min(Const(1), Max(Const(0), Sum([X, Const(1-k)]))) for integer X and k; if(c,a,b) == Sum([b, Mul(c, Sum([a, Mul(-1,b)]))]). The fallback is exact but unreadable; the variant is recommended.
E2 Expr::Ceil (49 ceil( calls) and Expr::Abs -- no exact fallback for ceil in the vocabulary.
E3 Expr::SkillRanks(SkillId) for skillinfo("TOTALRANK"|"RANK", skill) (182 calls across the family).
E4 Expr::CountHeld(category, key) for count("ABILITIES",...) (39 calls) -- else refuse.
E5 Expr::BonusCasterLevels(ClassId) for var("BL=X") when it appears without its var("CL=X") partner (the pair maps to CasterLevel(X)).
E6 equipment/encumbrance state (ENCUMBERANCE, var("COUNT[EQTYPE...]"), ARMORACCHECK, SHIELDACCHECK, MOVEBASE, CR) -- not character facts in §1; refuse or fold as words.
V1 a variable whose chain is DEFINEd only by a record outside the ingested books (231 names, 1,177 instances) -- refuse per name.
applies_shape: None. A VAR never constrains the holder; its gates constrain the ADDEND (rule G).
prose_effect: Through DESC %N substitution only: `DESC:DC %1|WitchHexDC_Ward` prints the folded number in the prose. TYPE=Boolean flags print their record's words unchanged.

rule: Target = ability abbreviation list (STR,DEX,CON,INT,WIS,CHA; comma list applies the same Expr to each; %LIST -> Choice(ability)). Value -> Expr; TYPE= -> bonus_type for the character-level fold (Racial is a STACKING type per BONUSSTACKS; Enhancement/Inherent/Alchemical/Insight/Profane/Size take the max). The sheet line is the ability score row: score = base + Sum(folded bonuses). One malformed target `BASESPELLSTAT;CLASS=Inquisitor|INT` (1 instance) -> refuse. 8,687 of 8,835 values are integer literals; 109 identifiers, 38 expressions, 1 mastervar (refuse). Stacking is a CHARACTER-level fold, not a record-level one (PCGen BonusManager.java:640-700, pinned 7f81800): untyped bonuses sum; two bonuses of the same TYPE take the max unless the type is in the game mode's stacking list (system/gameModes/Pathfinder/miscinfo.lst:17 BONUSSTACKS: Defense, Dodge, Circumstance, Racial, NotRanged, NotFlatFooted), a negative value always adds, `.STACK` always sums, `.REPLACE` replaces the plain-typed value (total = max(plain+stack, replace), BonusManager.java:475-489). Inside ONE record the converter folds tokens sharing (target, type) with that rule into one Expr: Sum([...]) for stacking types, Max(a, b) for a non-stacking type. Across records the live sheet-total evaluator applies the same rule, so the SheetRule must carry `target` and `bonus_type` (gap S1).
expr_shape: Const(2) typed Racial; Sum over held rules per (ability, type) at evaluation
expr_gaps: S1 SheetRule needs `target` and `bonus_type` fields so the live evaluator can fold same-type bonuses across records (see bonus.md §2).
applies_shape: The token itself adds no holder constraint. The record's own kind supplies Applies (class feature -> class+level, race trait -> race, feat -> feat). A trailing PRE field on the token is a per-token gate, folded per the family rule G (see bonus.md §3): build-settled gates fold into the Expr or into Applies; situational gates keep the number and append the condition to the label as words.
prose_effect: None; the number is the line.
